issue_context.title: Errors fetching Shelly Plus H&T data
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The integration configures Shelly Plus H&T devices with a sleep period of 7200 seconds, which may be too short for this device, but the main problem is that, every time a Plus H&T wakes up, an "**Error fetching data**" error is raised in the logs, while the entities of the device become unavailable for a moment to then become available again soon after.

The problem seems to have appeared in 2023.1.x releases.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.1.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.12.x

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Shelly

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/shelly/

### Diagnostics information

[config_entry-shelly-30ac10cacc1faf14e5a3ec7b6fda8bd9.json (3).txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/10406696/config_entry-shelly-30ac10cacc1faf14e5a3ec7b6fda8bd9.json.3.txt)
[config_entry-shelly-d789cf424096ea14f2d8212b9b58d916.json.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/10406697/config_entry-shelly-d789cf424096ea14f2d8212b9b58d916.json.txt)


### Example YAML snippet

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?


@thecode Thanks for looking into this. The fact that entities become unavailable whenever the device wakes up makes it practically impossible to use the sensor for any automation. Basically the integration raises an error for each device update and, at the same time, entities become unavailable for a few seconds.

I am also experiencing this issue. I have two Shelly Plus HT devices.

Problem does not occur on 2022.12.8.
Seeing this problem on 2023.1.x

Logger: homeassistant.components.shelly
Source: helpers/update_coordinator.py:201
Integration: Shelly (documentation, issues)
First occurred: 07:44:50 (2 occurrences)
Last logged: 07:45:42

Error fetching HT-Living data: Sleeping device did not update within 7200 seconds interval
Error fetching HT Office data: Sleeping device did not update within 43200 seconds interval

Initially the Shelly Plus HT devices were running an older firmware. Updated the firmware to the 0.12 release, but that does not seem to make a difference.

Both Shelly devices have the outbound websocket set as per the documentation to ws://172.16.227.10:8123/api/shelly/ws (No TLS validation).
Just to confirm that the problem is still there in 2023.1.5.

I still have this issue too after upgrading to 2023.1.5.
It only happens to Shelly Plus H&T. Doesn't matter if it is USB or battery powered. It happens almost randomly.
There is no need for additional confirmations, I will update when there are news about it.

This is still **not** fixed in 2023.1.6. Every time a Shelly Plus H&T wakes up to report, its entities become **unavailable** (which breaks automations based on their value) and the following (nonsense) errors are logged. I have 2 Shelly Plus H&T devices, they both have this problem and removing and re-adding them to the integration after upgrading to 2023.1.6 did not help.

```
2023-01-20 10:07:42.274 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.shelly] Error fetching Termostato Bagno Sopra data: Sleeping device did not update within 7200 seconds interval
2023-01-20 10:08:53.101 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.shelly] Error fetching Termostato Salone data: Sleeping device did not update within 7200 seconds interval
2023-01-20 10:13:46.271 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.shelly] Error fetching Termostato Bagno Sopra data: Sleeping device did not update within 7200 seconds interval
2023-01-20 10:13:56.920 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.shelly] Error fetching Termostato Salone data: Sleeping device did not update within 7200 seconds interval
```
Why commenting on a closed issue after you created a new one?
